summary: From-scratch validation of the documented environment setup in isolated per-experiment virtual environments on a Linux ARM64 CUDA GPU, using the synthetic-data smoke check only. No model weights and no benchmark datasets were downloaded.

runs.purpose: interpreter, venv, GPU, memory and network probe
network diagnosis (dead local proxy env vars; direct IPv4/IPv6 reachability)
pip download path check and torch cu132 aarch64 wheel listing
smoke environment from-scratch install plus gpu_synthetic_smoke.py
fallback environment from-scratch install plus import check

smoke_env.name: smoke-pylate120-20261115
smoke_env.install: python3.12 -m venv .venv-smoke; pip install torch==2.15.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu132; pip install -c torch-constraint.txt -r requirements-smoke.txt

fallback_env.name: fallback-pylate140-20261115
fallback_env.install: python3.12 -m venv .venv; pip install torch==2.15.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu132; pip install -c torch-constraint.txt -r requirements-base.txt; pip install --no-deps pylate==1.4.0

pip_check.output: pylate 1.4.0 requires fast-plaid, which is not installed.

fast_plaid_probe.binary_only: ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement fast-plaid (from versions: none)
fast_plaid_probe.any_distribution: ERROR: No matching distribution found for fast-plaid
fast_plaid_probe.conclusion: On Linux ARM64 with CPython 3.12 the default index offers no installable fast-plaid distribution, neither wheel nor sdist.

scope: Environment preparation only: isolated virtual environments created from scratch, dependency installation, import checks and the synthetic-data CUDA smoke training function. The full workflow (teacher scoring, dev-set gate, supervised and distilled training, test evaluation) was not run on this date.
limits: Synthetic smoke uses a randomly initialized tiny BERT and two training steps; it checks the CUDA training function, not model quality.
PyLate 1.2.0 (smoke) and 1.4.0 (fallback) have different loss implementations; smoke results do not transfer to the 1.4.0 experiment path.
The fallback environment omits fast-plaid and does not satisfy PyLate's complete dependencies; PLAID indexing remains unverified.
Model revisions and weight hashes of the original distillation run are still unconfirmed; no models were downloaded in this validation.
Verified on one Linux ARM64 CUDA device with Python 3.12; other platforms need their own verification.
